999008199.text:
ふう……助かりました。
皆さん、薬をありがとうございます

localizations.en: Phew... Thank goodness. Thank you all so much for the medicine.

999008199.text:
キノコが生えてしまった人は、栄養を吸われたのか
まだ起きていないが……あとは俺たちで面倒を見るよ

localizations.en: The ones who had mushrooms growing on them... they must have had their energy drained. They're still out cold, but we'll take it from here.

999008199.text: ええ。お大事にね

localizations.en: Of course. Take care of yourselves.

999008199.text:
目的の美術品収集家も寝込んでるみたいだね。
回復を待つしかないか

localizations.en: Sounds like the art collector we were after is still bedridden too. Guess we'll just have to wait for them to recover.

999008199.text:
突然変異したキノコの魔物が島を埋め尽くそうと
するなんて、想像以上の異常事態だったね

localizations.en: Mutant mushroom monsters trying to overrun an entire island... even I have to admit, that was a worse situation than expected.

999008199.text:
ピルッツァは諸島同盟の外。
緊急連絡網が機能しない。大惨事寸前だった

localizations.en: Piruzza lies outside the Archipelago Federation. Emergency networks do not reach here. This came dangerously close to a catastrophe.

999008199.text: 本当に間に合ってよかった……

localizations.en: I'm just so glad we made it in time...

999008199.text:
レスナたちも体調が戻ったみたいだし、
宿に入れてもらって、しばらく町の復興を手伝いましょ

localizations.en: Resna and the others seem to be back on their feet, so let's get ourselves a room at the inn and help the town recover for a while.

999008199.text:
（あれからしばらくして……みんなすっかり
　元気になったみたい。子どもたちも走り回って……）

localizations.en: (A little while after that... everyone seemed to have made a full recovery. Even the children were running around again...)

999008199.text:
（ああやって、みんなで遊ぶの、いいな……
　私も、ああいう輪の中に入ってみたい……）

localizations.en: (It looks so nice, everyone playing together like that... I want to be part of something like that too...)

999008199.text: （でも、どうやって声をかければ……）

localizations.en: (But how would I even ask to join...)

999008199.text: ……あ、あの

やべ！　もうこんな時間か！
母ちゃんに店を手伝えって言われてたの忘れてた！

localizations.en: Oh no! Is it that late already?! I totally forgot Mom asked me to help out at the shop!

999008199.text: 私も、お勉強をしないと……またね！

localizations.en: I still have to study too... See you later!

999008199.text: ……行っちゃいましたね
ひゃっ！　も、もしかして、今の、見て……？

localizations.en: Eek! W-were you watching that whole time...?

999008199.text:
うん。キューンちゃんの気持ち、分かるなあ。
私も昔は――

localizations.en: Yeah. I think I know how you feel. When I was younger, I used to—

999008199.text: ッ！

キューンちゃん！？
……うう、失敗しちゃったかな。声のかけ方

localizations.en: Quinn...?! ...Oh no, that wasn't the right thing to say, was it. I shouldn't have pushed.

999008199.text: なんだか昔の私を思い出すなあ

localizations.en: She reminds me so much of how I used to be...

999008199.text:
……私にとってのイザナちゃんみたいな子が、
キューンちゃんにも見つかるといいな

localizations.en: ...I hope she finds someone like Izana someday.
